summary: The host discusses a new initiative offering seed funding, training, and mentorship to 12 teams, noting that Jenna Weiss-Berman of Pineapple Street Media and Amit Dashi serve as co-chairs of the advisory committee. Additionally, the host promotes the #PodsInColor hashtag for podcast discovery, mentions an upcoming meetup in Boston, and introduces guest Favi (Justin Favela) from Five V Five of Latinos Who Lunch.
